semantics.identity_rule: Each page has an explicit identity.
semantics.root_rule: Each page belongs to exact site tree/root.
semantics.order_rule: Sibling presentation order is explicit metadata, not semantic priority.
semantics.route_rule: Page identity is separate from route/path binding.
semantics.visibility_rule: Hidden/nav-excluded state does not change authorization.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: page path reused as page identity only

references.purpose: Pages belong to exact site structure.
